previewAvailable.description: The channel shows its posts on the web; without it only subscribers and description are available.

mediaCounts.description: Photos, videos, links and files the channel has posted.

postsAnalyzed.description: Recent posts the statistics are based on.

statsBasedOnPosts.description: Settled posts the views, reach and engagement are averaged over: 2 to 30 days old, or the newest 20 older than 48 hours.

firstPostAt.description: Date of the oldest post analysed.

active.description: Posted in the last 30 days. Silent channels get no price estimate: their views come from old posts.

postsPerDay.description: Posts per day over the posts analysed.

avgViews.description: Average views per post, from posts older than 48 hours (their views have settled).

medianViews.description: Median views per post, from posts older than 48 hours.

reachPercent.description: Average views as a percentage of subscribers (ERR): how much of the audience actually reads.

engagementPercent.description: Reactions as a percentage of views.

viewsTrendPercent.description: Change of median views from the older to the newer half of the posts analysed.

forwardedPercent.description: Share of posts forwarded from other chats.

adPosts.description: Posts with ad markers (erid, #реклама, #ad, ad law labels).

adPercent.description: Ad posts as a percentage of the posts analysed.

lastAdPostAt.description: Date of the latest ad post.

estimatedPostPriceUsd.description: Average views / 1000 × your CPM: a reference price for one ad post. Empty for channels silent for 30 days.

cpmUsd.description: CPM used for the price estimate.

script.description: Main script of the posts: Cyrillic, Latin, Thai, Arabic, CJK and others.

topPosts.description: The three most viewed posts analysed.

linkedChannels.description: Channels this channel mentions or forwards from, with the number of posts.

contacts.description: Usernames, t.me links, emails and websites in the channel description (often the ad contact).

foundBy.description: input, or which input channels mentioned it.
